The move comes alongside a fourth-quarter loss of 23 cents a share and a 5% decline in full-year net sales to $9.7 billion. CEO Mick Beekhuizen acknowledged performance isn't where it needs to be and said the company is taking decisive action. Full-year cash flow from operations totaled $1 billion, with the company returning $496 million to shareholders primarily through dividends
